saved.start_policy: fresh matched log-off initialization in every case; probe checkpoint states are not reused
saved.selection_rule: persistent only if finite monotone trajectories, no worse on both cases within relative 1e-8, and worst terminal objective ratio improves by at least 1e-4; otherwise reset; reject followup if neither is finite monotone on both

frozen_followup.start_policy: fresh matched log-off initialization in every case; probe checkpoint states are not reused
frozen_followup.checkpoint_policy: final state only, retained before independent scoring

optimizer_probe.limits: Training-only continuation probes on two already opened partial datasets; no independent diagnostics or hidden-field labels selected the rule.

costs.scope: Fit times in each row exclude later scoring. Probe and wrapper elapsed times are distinct records and are not summed into CPU time.

state.scope: frozen old/new focused spatial software regression checks; no named scientific campaign
complete repository software tests; no named scientific campaign

quality_checks.overlap_policy: Separate invocations are reported independently; overlapping focused tests are not added to the full-suite count.
quality_checks.exact_head_ci: Not asserted; verify after the resulting source commit.

interpretation_limits: Every pass/fail is a saved coordinator gate; this helper never fits, scores, re-gates, or selects a checkpoint.
All four declared cases remain in the denominator, including failed or unrun cases.
The rule jointly changes learning rate, optimizer history and fixed budget relative to the 80-update log-off baseline; this is not an isolated causal test of optimizer history.
Training-only probes and fresh initializations reuse already opened development datasets; no independent replication or fresh-cohort generalization is claimed.
Fixed final updates are budget endpoints and do not certify convergence.
Near-interface and near-bottom audits remain report only, even when their values exceed primary limits.
Full coordinate arrays, readout records and update trajectories remain in indexed raw reports; compact hashes and JSON pointers bind them.
No inverse recovery, untouched reserved-cohort evaluation, hardware validation, or 3D validation is established.
